to

Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01145
⌈The function CanSM_StopWakeupSource shall return E_NOT_OK, if the CanSM

[SWS_CanSM_00621]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01145
⌈The function CanSM_StopWakeupSource shall call the function Det_ReportError (ref. to [SWS_CanSM_91003]) with ErrorId parameter CANSM_E_INVALID_

invalid concerning the CanSM configuration (ref. to [ECUC_CanSM_00161]).⌋
